facts.statement: Goodradigbeeon is a genus of extinct fish.
The type species of the genus is Goodradigbeeon australianum.
The genus was described by White in 1978.
The holotype was discovered near the Goodradigbee River by Harry A. Toombs.
facts.quote: The holotype was discovered near the Goodradigbee River by Harry A. Toombs

facts.statement: Goodradigbeeon belongs to the parent group Homostiidae.
Goodradigbeeon is classified in the family Homostiidae.
Goodradigbeeon is a member of the class Placodermi.
Goodradigbeeon lived during the Emsian stage, between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Emsian to Emsian (410.62 to 393.47 million years ago)
